items.summary: Behavioural intelligence layer for OpenClaw agents. Monitors live decisions, forces transparent financial reasoning before any purchase, detects SOUL identit...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release. Behavioural intelligence layer for OpenClaw agents.

Blacklight watches what your agent actually does during a session, not just what it has access to. It reads your entire setup on first load, builds a personalised Agent Profile, and monitors against 17 named threat patterns across autonomy, injection, trust, exfiltration, and epistemic categories.

Forces transparent reasoning before any purchase, payment, or investment. Detects SOUL.md identity drift. Flags memory entries planted by external content. Maps dangerous permission combinations across installed skills. Tracks multi-agent authority chains. Provides emergency shutdown with a single command.

Silent by default. Speaks up when it matters. Everything configurable.

Not tested against a live instance yet. Needs community testing across models and configurations. If you run it, please open an issue with what you found.
